title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_707
description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a potential Mirai botnet infection within your organization's network. The Mirai botnet is known for turning IoT devices into a botnet for launching distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. Your goal is to identify and mitigate the botnet activity.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a potential Mirai botnet infection within your organization's network. The Mirai botnet is known for turning IoT devices into a botnet for launching distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. Your goal is to identify and mitigate the botnet activity.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: To access the sandbox in the cloud, use the following credentials: username: cyrano, password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content: To access the local sandbox, use the following credentials: username: cyrano, password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: While monitoring network traffic, you have noticed unusual outbound connections from one of the hosts. Your task is to identify the service responsible for this suspicious behavior. Submit the service name.
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, you need to enumerate running services and look for any unusual or recently added services. Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently added services. The service name should be identified and reported.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently added services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any services that are generating a high volume of traffic.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious service is likely to have a name that indicates its malicious intent.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Traffic Service
levels.content: You have observed a significant increase in network traffic originating from the same host. Your task is to identify the service responsible for this abnormal traffic. Submit the service name.
levels.solution: To identify the service responsible for the abnormal traffic, you need to examine the network connections and look for any services that are generating a high volume of traffic. The service name should be identified and reported.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the network connections and look for any services that are generating a high volume of traffic.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use tools like netstat or ss to examine the network connections.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The service generating abnormal traffic is likely to have a name that indicates its malicious intent.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: You need to understand how the identified suspicious service maintains its persistence on the system. Investigate the persistence mechanism used by the service. Submit the timer name.
levels.solution: To determine the persistence mechanism, you need to check the systemd timers and look for any timers associated with the suspicious service. The persistence mechanism should be identified and reported.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd timers and look for any timers associated with the suspicious service.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any cron jobs or scheduled tasks that might be associated with the suspicious service.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The persistence mechanism is likely to be a timer with a name that indicates its malicious intent.
